definitions.Policy Change: Whether or how the privacy policy may change, and how users are informed of changes.
definitions.Third Party Sharing/Collection: Disclosure of user information to third parties, or collection of user information by third parties.
definitions.User Choice/Control: Choices users have about collection, use, or sharing of their information, including consent and opting out.
definitions.Data Retention: How long user information is kept, or criteria governing the storage period.
definitions.User Access Edit and Deletion: Whether and how users can access, correct, update, or delete their stored information.
definitions.International and Specific Audiences: Practices applying to specific populations, such as children or residents of particular countries or regions.
definitions.Data Security: Measures to protect user information, or statements about the security of that information.
definitions.Do Not Track: Whether and how browser Do Not Track signals are honored.
definitions.First Party Collection/Use: Information the service provider collects or uses, including how and why it does so.
definitions.Other: Introductions, general policy statements, scope, headings, dates, privacy contact information, and substantive privacy practices outside the nine specific categories.
